text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No data are available with regard to overdosage in humans. Anticipated symptoms of an overdose may be severe nausea, vomiting, and headache. In the event of an overdose, appropriate supportive treatment should be initiated as dictated by the patient’s clinical signs and symptoms. A prolonged period of observation and treatment for these symptoms may be necessary, taking into account the half-life of TANZEUM (5 days).
